scope_boundary: Neutral scientific capacity model. It does not state or determine an administrative allocation.

measured_prior_evidence.interpretation: Preliminary compute-feasibility anchor only; no theoretical conversion to other GPU architectures.

formulae.gpu_hours: sum(cases * model_cells * configurations * seeds * variants * seconds_per_case * gpus_per_job / 3600)

minimum.purpose: Required dataset, QA and minimum A/B/C baselines.

planned.purpose: Bounded benchmark/test corpus, pipeline QA, portability, scalability and required A/B/C performance tests.

ceiling.activation_gate: Only after planned-scenario QA, review-capacity and compute-efficiency gates pass.
ceiling.purpose: Non-default expansion ceiling; not an automatic target.

required_m1_measurements: CPU parsing, normalization, schema/catalogue validation, deduplication and leakage wall time
CPU allocated cores, peak RAM and I/O size
GPU mean, median and p95 latency over 100-200 cases per relevant configuration
GPU tokens/s, peak VRAM, batch size, input/output length and failure/retry rate
storage growth per dataset version and per benchmark run
stop_rules: Do not execute optional adaptation before dataset and required baseline gates pass.
If p95 exceeds 30 seconds per case, remove optional adaptation first, then optional variants and non-essential repeats.
If p95 approaches or exceeds 60 seconds per case, reduce optional cells or models before proposing any envelope change.
Do not expand to the ceiling scenario when review capacity or QA gates fail.
Do not hide failed runs or remove them from denominators.
Do not infer A100 runtime from T4 theoretical FLOPS.
